F4: Calendar/UI/simulationpause/frameconversion/skip/active-unloadedrepresentation differ; no OSofflinebehavior follows. Winterfundedadvance/severity/grace/fuel/heatrange/bodyprotection/cold/work/waste has actualexceptions; success-inducedpressure is source-specific, not mandatorybalancing. No purchases/entitlementcall or currentversion/date claim.

Existingownedpeople/jobs/stock/knowledge/conditions/nativeleases need currentoverlapcheck; missingjoin claims are dated possibilities.
